message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation, what reading effect does the opening “/**” have: can you tell whether it belongs to the story? Which punctuation deserves attention first, and what evidence in your draft supports that judgment? Why would further thought be worth its time over trying an edit now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make waiting more useful? Could you briefly state your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next intention in English, then carry out that choice?
